power.method: Heater-equipped positioning camera (100W heater on / 25W heater off)

features: ONVIF Profile S/G, SUNAPI, Wisenet open platform
release_notes: Ingest 2026-09-08 from official datasheet (DataSheet_TNU-6320_180410, first edition 04-2018; Russian-language edition parsed). NOTE: despite the 'TNU' prefix this is NOT a thermal camera - it is a visible-light 2MP 32x positioning (PTZ) camera. Verified: 2MP (1920x1080), 4.44-142.6mm 32x optical zoom F1.6, min illumination 0.3 lux color / 0.03 lux B/W, H.264/MJPEG (no H.265), max 60fps@2M, WDR 120dB + Defog, 360 endless pan / tilt -90 to +40, mechanical ICR, built-in heater (100W on / 25W off), IP66, operating -40 to 55C, 219x460x528mm. No IR illuminator (night_vision type none). Connector/voltage and weight were not machine-readable and are omitted (not fabricated).

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

blue_iris.notes: Select 'Hanwha' (or 'Samsung' on older Blue Iris versions).
